item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH- ‘Abhishek Sharma has to put a price on his wicket’- Manoj Tiwary slams opener’s loose shots
item.description: Former India batter Manoj Tiwary has criticized the way opener Abhishek Sharma got out in the recent India v West Indies Super 8s game of the ongoing T20 World Cup 2026. India won the game by 5 wickets, thanks to Sanju Samson’s 97*, and qualified for the semi-final of the event. However, focus was on Abhishek Sharma, who had regained some form against Zimbabwe with a sublime fifty but could only manage 10 runs against the West Indies in Kolkata. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH- “Takes a lot of character”- Gambhir lauds Rinku Singh for rejoining the team after his father’s demise
item.description: Team India head coach Gautam Gambhir lauded Rinku Singh for showing great courage and character in rejoining the Indian team after his father’s demise in the midst of the T20 World Cup 2026. Rinku Singh’s father, Khanchand, was admitted to a hospital in Noida as he battled with cancer, and his condition worsened. item.title: RCB to play five home matches of IPL 2026 season at Chinnaswamy Stadium
item.description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) will play five of their home matches at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium here and the remaining two fixtures at Raipur's Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh International Stadium during the 2026 edition of Indian Premier League (IPL), the franchise confirmed on Tuesday (March 3). The announcement ended speculations about whether the defending IPL champions would be able to play at their home ground in Bengaluru, following the tragic stampede episode last year. item.title: Indian women's cricket team shortlisted for prestigious Laureus Award
item.description: The Indian women's cricket squad has been shortlisted for the esteemed 2026 Laureus World Team of the Year Award following their maiden World Cup title triumph. The Harmanpreet Kaur-led side is the first women's cricket team to receive this nomination, a recognition for their awe-inspiring display in the showpiece tournament. item.description: Team India are set to face England in the second semifinal of the T20 World Cup 2026 at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai on Thursday (March 5). Two days ahead of the knockout fixture, the Men in Blue rescheduled their training session for a peculiar reason. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: ‘Resisted Babar’s inclusion, wanted Rizwan instead of Usman’- Aleem Dar resigns as Pakistan selector- Report
item.description: Senior Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) selection committee member and ex-international umpire Aleem Dar has reportedly resigned from his post in the aftermath of the Pakistan team’s failure to qualify for the semi-final of the ongoing T20 World Cup 2026. item.title: IPL 2026: ‘Can't be dependent on Virat all the time’- RCB’s Mo Bobat on choosing Rajat Patidar as captain though Kohli was ready
item.description: RCB director of cricket Mo Bobat has revealed the reasoning why the Royal Challengers Bengaluru franchise chose Rajat Patidar as their captain for IPL 2025, despite Virat Kohli being ready to take over the leadership role. RCB finally ended their 18-year wait for an RCB trophy when they defeated Punjab Kings (PBKS) in the final to win their maiden IPL title. item.title: “He's an out-and-out match-winner,” Shastri, Ponting throw weight behind struggling Abhishek Sharma ahead of T20 World Cup semis
item.description: Heading into the T20 World Cup 2026, Abhishek Sharma was expected to be India's destroyer-in-chief. However, the southpaw failed to live up to the hype so far. While Abhishek failed to open his account in the Group A fixtures against USA, Pakistan and Netherlands, he managed to score 15 off 12 balls in the Super 8 opener against South Africa. item.description: India and England are set to square off in the second semifinal of the Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 at the Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai on Thursday (March 5). item.title: “Delighted to be in commentary box rather than facing him”: Sunil Gavaskar’s rich praise for Jasprit Bumrah
item.description: Jasprit Bumrah has been India’s real impact bowler in the ongoing T20 World Cup. Skipper Suryakumar Yadav has used him in different phases and the pace spearhead has certainly delivered for the team, claiming 9 wickets in 6 matches so far at an economy rate of 6.30.
